world_org_meetings.title: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
world_org_meetings.description: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the prime minister was "unpicking" the deal the UK signed with the EU.

world_org_meetings.title: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
world_org_meetings.description: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

world_org_meetings.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
world_org_meetings.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 trade ministers are meeting in Wisconsin. Many will be discussing deals without their U.S. host
world_org_meetings.description: Most of the officials attending the G20 trade ministers' meeting in Milwaukee, Wisc., find themselves in challenging positions, largely because of U.S. President Donald Trump's global tariff agenda. It makes for a potentially unusual summit, with high-level meetings on the sidelines where different countries discuss plans to work around the host.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump’s tariffs loom over talks as G20 meets in US
world_org_meetings.description: Trade ministers of the Group of 20 are meeting in Milwaukee for two days of talks on Wednesday, but US President Donald Trump’s tariffs are expected to hang heavy over the talks. "Don't expect any breakthroughs," an analyst watching the event said.

diplomatic_visits.title: Spain's royals to visit Ceuta as territory grapples with protracted migration crisis
diplomatic_visits.description: Spain's King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia are visiting Ceuta to show solidarity with residents facing a migration crisis

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta an 'inalienable' part of Spain, king says on key visit
diplomatic_visits.description: King Felipe VI on Tuesday said Ceuta and Melilla were "an inalienable part" of Spain as he made a landmark visit to the north African territories claimed by neighbouring Morocco. "Ceuta and Melilla are an inalienable part of the political and national reality that is Spain. The sovereignty and territorial integrity of our country are not negotiable," Felipe said. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta crowds affirm Spanish identity during royal visit
diplomatic_visits.description: King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia received a rapturous welcome in Ceuta on Tuesday, 13 October, as they began their first visit to the Spanish North African territory since 2007.

diplomatic_visits.title: Ceuta awaits King Felipe after summer migration crisis
diplomatic_visits.description: Ceuta braces for a symbolic royal visit by King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia after a mass migration crisis strained the enclave’s social cohesion.

diplomatic_visits.title: Spain’s king visits Ceuta amid tensions with Morocco
diplomatic_visits.description: King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia are visiting Ceuta months after more than 70,000 migrants arrived from Morocco. While most have returned, thousands remain. The visit has divided residents and risks reigniting diplomatic tensions with Morocco, which claims sovereignty over Ceuta and Melilla.

elections.title: Russia did try to interfere with Brexit vote but had little impact, MI5 chief says
elections.description: It comes after Andy Burnham said Moscow had tried to interfere in the 2016 referendum.

elections.title: How the ICE surge in Minnesota could impact the midterms
elections.description: Operation Metro Surge is still a "fresh wound" in Minnesota, where a sweeping immigration crackdown saw thousands of arrested and two U.S. citizens killed. Minnesotans organized grassroots opposition against the federal officers. Now many of those same people have signed up for training to protect the polls in a Senate race that could be pivotal.

elections.title: What to know about France's high school student protests
elections.description: France faces nationwide student protests that are destabilizing the government and influencing the presidential election campaign

elections.title: Scientists urge tighter AI controls to prevent global cyber risks
elections.description: Call comes amid polls casting doubts on political leaders' ability to manage AI risks as US midterm elections near.

elections.title: French presidential candidate Glucksmann says 'battle begins' to unite fragmented left
elections.description: French presidential candidate Raphaël Glucksmann said Monday that the "battle begins" to revive the country's divided left ahead of the 2027 election. The EU lawmaker was elected Sunday as the centre-left candidate with more than 66 percent of the vote.
